bio.text: Jessica Hart Steinmann is a candidate for Congress in Texas's 8th District, according to her campaign website.

The website says she was Director of the Office for Victims of Crime in the U.S. Department of Justice during the Trump administration, then Executive General Counsel at the America First Policy Institute, and earlier worked in the office of U.S. Senator Ted Cruz.
According to the website, she was born and attended high school in Harris County and now lives in Montgomery County with her husband, Brandon, the Montgomery County Clerk, and their two sons.
